description: Design the merge subsystem for Git Control Tower: API contract for merge/status/abort endpoints, conflict data model (how to represent conflicting hunks with ours/theirs/base content), three-way merge UX evaluation (Monaco editor capabilities for merge conflict rendering), per-conflict resolution actions (accept ours, accept theirs, manual edit), merge commit composition flow, and configurable branch protection rules for blocking merges until review readiness is green.
name: gct-merge-architecture
title: Design merge API, conflict model, and three-way merge UX
